title: Lumi and the Lost Firefly
note: Voice-production cue sheet for the TRILYVA cartoon example. Generate each cue separately in ElevenLabs, keep each file's spoken duration within its cue window, then assemble the clips at the listed start times. Audio has not been generated by this repository file.

performance_direction.narrator: Warm, reassuring storybook narration. Gentle phrasing, clear consonants, small emotional lifts at discoveries; never rushed.
performance_direction.lumi: Curious, kind, active and expressive. Natural youthful energy without exaggerated baby talk.
performance_direction.firefly: Light, bright, gentle and slightly breathy, with a small hopeful lift. Keep the words easy to understand.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: At twilight, Lumi spotted a lonely little light trembling in the grass.

cues.speaker: LUMI
cues.text: Hey, little glow. Why are you all alone?
cues.direction: Gentle curiosity; a small pause after 'glow'.

cues.speaker: FIREFLY
cues.text: I lost my family. My light is too tiny!
cues.direction: Sad at first, then a little embarrassed; not crying.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: Lumi folded a broad leaf around a shining drop of dew, making a tiny lantern.
cues.direction: Patient, tactile storytelling; emphasize the small clever solution.

cues.speaker: LUMI
cues.text: We'll follow the creek. Stay close to my lantern!

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: They hopped from stone to stone while the water painted silver stars.
cues.direction: Lightly rhythmic; give the image room to breathe.

cues.speaker: FIREFLY
cues.text: That old willow! My family gathers there!

cues.speaker: LUMI
cues.text: Then let's make the darkest path sparkle!
cues.direction: Bright, inviting, with a smile in the voice.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: One firefly answered, then ten, then a thousand tiny lights filled the clearing.
cues.direction: Build wonder through the line; keep the last phrase spacious.

cues.speaker: FIREFLY
cues.text: You found them! Thank you, Lumi!

cues.speaker: LUMI
cues.direction: Quiet, affectionate friendship; finish before the final frame.
